methodology: Gini coefficient of income, computed over 10% (decile) population groups. 0.283 for Q1 2026 -- low by international standards. The dataset held POVERTY_HEADCOUNT but no measure of how income is DISTRIBUTED, so a falling poverty rate could not be told apart from a widening gap above the poverty line. The source also publishes a quintile-based Gini (0.269 for the same quarter); this is the decile one, the finer partition.
